KISWAHILI — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Copy random text without understanding Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Matamshi Bora Sauti.
